content: Group {{groupName}} will be deleted. Users in the group will not be removed from the workspace. Are you sure you want to continue?

comment.text: Body text in a confirmation dialog that appears when deleting a group, containing the {{groupName}} variable to specify the name of the group being removed.

usage.context:
<Text>
 {hasMoreGroups
 ? t("DeleteDialog:DeleteAllGroupDescription", {
 productName: getBrandName("ProductName"),
 })
 : t("DeleteDialog:DeleteGroupDescription", {
 productName: getBrandName("ProductName"),
 groupName,
 })}
 </Text>
 </ModalDialog.Body>
